beats.text: Every day, the Church remembers a saint. Most of them, the world has forgotten.
beats.scene: A long procession of saints of every era and land (martyrs with palms, desert monks, nuns, bishops, missionaries from Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas) walking toward Christ enthroned in glory.

beats.text: Martyrs of Rome. Monks of the desert. Missionaries who crossed oceans and never came home.
Each day here, one of them. A true story, told in a minute, on their feast day.
beats.scene: An old monk-scribe at a lectern by candlelight, illuminating a great open book of the lives of the saints, small painted saints visible on its pages.

beats.text: History where we know it. Tradition where we don't. Always with reverence.
beats.scene: Desert hermits in a rocky wilderness beside a small chapel, and far off on the sea a wooden mission ship under sail carrying friars to distant lands.

beats.text: The saints the world forgot. Heaven didn't.
beats.scene: The court of Heaven: countless haloed saints gathered in rows on gold around the Lamb, rays of light descending, angels holding crowns.

caption:
Welcome to All Saints. ✝

Every day, one saint the world forgot, on their feast day: martyrs, monks, missionaries, mystics. A true story in about a minute.

History where we know it. Tradition where we don't. Always with reverence.

Follow to meet a new saint each morning.

The saints the world forgot. Heaven didn't.
All Saints, pray for us. 🕯
